$comment: When the next editions of the publications this release reads are expected (Home v2 'Coming up', 2026-11-23). Not data: nothing here is a figure, and nothing here is shown as a fact. Every entry is 'expected' unless the agency announced the date, in which case 'status' is 'announced' and 'announcedAt' is the agency's own page that says so. 'when' is a month (YYYY-MM) for an expected entry, a day (YYYY-MM-DD) only for an announced one. 'basis' says why it is expected then, in words. scripts/checks/home-calendar.mjs checks every entry and every date the home page shows from this file.
